# Real Estate Capital Resources (RECR)
> Capital-path guidance for real-estate investors. Property-first review across purchase, rehab, rental, bridge, construction, commercial, multifamily, portfolio, and joint-venture structures.

Site: https://realestatecapitalresources.com/
Markets: Cleveland, OH and Fort Lauderdale / South Florida
Phone: 954-676-4205
Email: fabercapitalresources@gmail.com
Address: 1273 W 6th St, Cleveland, OH 44113

## Confirmed differentiator (mockup; owner-confirmed, not yet launch-approved)
- Up to 100% of purchase, rehab, and closing costs on qualifying joint-venture transactions
- When total project cost is within 70% of after-repair value (ARV)
- Always subject to ARV support, documentation, economics, availability, underwriting, and final approval
- Not all transactions qualify
